NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Modification to Tentative Tract Map No. 64417 and Design Review DR-2011-08 Applicant: Tri Pointe Homes, LLC
Location: Rosedale (Promenade District - Garden Court Neighborhood)
APN: 8625-005-064/ 065
A request for approval to modify an existing approved Tentative Tract Map (TTM) No. 64417 and to obtain Design Review approval for a new architectural product developed by Tri Pointe Homes, which would be built instead of the previously approved "Arborview" architectural product originally built by Fieldstone Communities.

3.
Design Review DR-2011-03 and Variances V-2011-01 & V-2011-03 Applicant: Kun Yuan Lin (Kwan Lin) - property owner
APN: 8605-017-413
Location: 742 N. Todd Avenue
A request for approval of a Design Review and two Variance applications to allow the construction of a 14,498 sq.ft. industrial warehouse building with supporting office area located in the West End Light Industrial District (DWL) zone. Two variances are requested as a part of the application; the first is related to the proposed parking configuration and the second variance is requested to allow a reduced north side setback for the proposed building.
